business.title: What kind of business is this?
business.description: e.g. 'a café in Portland', 'a two-person electrical contractor'.

tools.name: register_status
tools.description: What is overdue and due soon on the register, each with its owner, days left and the last proof on file. Call it first when asked what's due.

tools.name: add_obligation
tools.description: Save an obligation to the register: title, category, next due date (YYYY-MM-DD), how it recurs, owner and authority. An existing title is updated, never duplicated. Call it as soon as one is mentioned, before you describe it.

tools.name: complete_obligation
tools.description: Record that an obligation was done, with the reference number or certificate exactly as given. A recurring one rolls to its next due date. Call it the moment the person says it's done.

tools.name: set_obligation_status
tools.description: Mark an obligation in progress (or back to open).

tools.name: log_evidence
tools.description: File proof against an obligation: a note with the reference number, or the path of an uploaded file under evidence/.

tools.name: list_obligations
tools.description: Every obligation on the register with its status, due date and proof.

tools.name: page_complete_obligation
tools.description: Record that an obligation was done.
